name: le.stalk
description: Collections as predicates, bills of materials in three layers, and lineage as typed edges — the family, modelled so a build can disagree with it.

pitches.reader: Five collections evaluated against the family, a bill of materials for every seed, and the lineage graph with its gaps named.
pitches.grower: The model that tells you what a seed inherits, what it is made of, and which claims are still unverified.
pitches.maintainer: A guard that refuses a lineage cycle, a graft without a claim and a collection that quietly matches nothing.
pitches.packager: The dilly-bean isotope: trace a seed’s inheritance and its bill of materials, with five refusals.
